field--type-string-long field--label-hidden field__item">Facts and figures on the state of the world’s freshwater resources from the 2024 UN World Water Development Report: Water for Prosperity and Peace.</div></div><div class="content-narrow"><div class="last-update"><span>Last update:</span><span>26 February 2024</span></div><aside class="content-summary summary-simple page"><div class="item-list"><h3>Summary</h3><ul><li class="summary-item"><a href="/reports/wwdr/en/2024/s#water-demand-and-use" class="summary-link">Water demand and use</a></li><li class="summary-item"><a href="/reports/wwdr/en/2024/s#water-availability-and-stress" class="summary-link">Water availability and stress</a></li><li class="summary-item"><a href="/reports/wwdr/en/2024/s#extreme-events" class="summary-link">Extreme events</a></li><li class="summary-item"><a href="/reports/wwdr/en/2024/s#progress-towards-sustainable-development-goal-sdg-6" class="summary-link">Progress towards Sustainable Development Goal (SDG) 6</a></li><li class="summary-item"><a href="/reports/wwdr/en/2024/s#sdg-6-indicators" class="summary-link">SDG 6 indicators</a></li></ul></div></aside><div ng-cloak="" ng-app="ods-widgets" class="field field--name-field-paragraphs field--type-entity-reference-revisions field--label-hidden field__items"><div class="field__item"><div data-trk="{&quot;block&quot;:{&quot;name&quot;:&quot;Water demand and use&quot;,&quot;format&quot;:&quot;rich_text&quot;}}" id="water-demand-and-use" class="paragraph paragraph--type--rich-text paragraph--view-mode--default"><div class="field field--name-field-title field--type-string field--label-hidden field__item"><h2>Water demand and use</h2></div><div class="rich-text clearfix text-formatted field field--name-field-text field--type-text-long field--label-hidden field__item"><ul><li>Worldwide, agriculture accounts for roughly 70% of freshwater withdrawals, followed by industry (just under 20%) and domestic (or municipal) uses (about 12%).</li><li>Groundwater supplies about 25% of all water used for irrigation and half of the freshwater withdrawn for domestic purposes.</li><li>Since 1980s the global demand for freshwater has been increasing by just under 1% per year during this period.</li><li>Water demand from the municipal sector has experienced a considerable increase relative to the other sectors (Figure P.2) and is likely to continue growing as populations urbanize and the water supply and sanitation systems servicing these cities expand.&nbsp;</li></ul></div></div></div><div class="field__item"><div data-trk="{&quot;block&quot;:{&quot;name&quot;:&quot;Statistics \u003E Paragraphs&quot;,&quot;format&quot;:&quot;media&quot;}}" id="" class="paragraph-simple display-big paragraph paragraph--type--media paragraph--view-mode--default"><div class="wrapper-medias"><div class="field field--name-field-ref-submedia field--type-entity-reference field--label-hidden field__items"><div class="field__item"><div class="submedia"><div class="media media--type-image media--view-mode-media-big"><div class="field field--name-field-media-image field--type-image field--label-hidden field__item"> <picture> <source srcset="/reports/wwdr/sites/default/files/styles/media_image_big_desktop/public/2024-02/FP2_carousel_0.jpg.webp?itok=bot2wpFn 1x" media="all and (min-width: 993px)" type="image/webp" width="1038" height="692"/> <source srcset="/reports/wwdr/sites/default/files/styles/medium_fixed_tablet/public/2024-02/FP2_carousel_0.jpg.webp?itok=sq6xgHMk 1x" media="all and (min-width: 576px) and (max-width: 992px)" type="image/webp" width="700" height="466"/> <source srcset="/reports/wwdr/sites/default/files/styles/split_mobile/public/2024-02/FP2_carousel_0.jpg.webp?itok=ZnGwsNJ1 1x" media="all and (max-width: 575px)" type="image/webp" width="375" height="252"/> <img loading="lazy" width="375" height="252" src="/reports/wwdr/sites/default/files/styles/split_mobile/public/2024-02/FP2_carousel_0.jpg.webp?itok=ZnGwsNJ1" alt="Increase in water withdrawals for different sectors, 1960-2014" class="img-fluid" /> </picture></div></div><div class="field field--type-string field--label-inline field--name-field-copyright clearfix ">Source: Otto and Schleifer (2020)</div></div></div></div></div></div></div><div class="field__item"><div data-trk="{&quot;block&quot;:{&quot;name&quot;:&quot;Water availability and stress&quot;,&quot;format&quot;:&quot;rich_text&quot;}}" id="water-availability-and-stress" class="paragraph paragraph--type--rich-text paragraph--view-mode--default"><div class="field field--name-field-title field--type-string field--label-hidden field__item"><h2>Water availability and stress</h2></div><div class="rich-text clearfix text-formatted field field--name-field-text field--type-text-long field--label-hidden field__item"><ul><li>Roughly half of the world’s population experiences severe water scarcity for at least part of the year.</li><li>Water deficits were linked to a 10% increase in global migration between 1970–2000.</li></ul></div></div></div><div class="field__item"><div data-trk="{&quot;block&quot;:{&quot;name&quot;:&quot;Water quality and pollution&quot;,&quot;format&quot;:&quot;rich_text&quot;}}" id="water-quality-and-pollution" class="paragraph paragraph--type--rich-text paragraph--view-mode--default"><div class="field field--name-field-title field--type-string field--label-hidden field__item"><h2>Water quality and pollution</h2></div><div class="rich-text clearfix text-formatted field field--name-field-text field--type-text-long field--label-hidden field__item"><ul><li>In lower-income countries, poor water quality is due to low levels of wastewater treatment. whereas in higher-income countries, runoff from agriculture poses the most serious problem.</li><li>Emerging contaminants include pharmaceuticals, hormones, industrial chemicals, detergents, cyanotoxins, per- and poly-fluoroalkyl substances (PFAS) and nanomaterials.</li></ul></div></div></div><div class="field__item"><div data-trk="{&quot;block&quot;:{&quot;name&quot;:&quot;Extreme events&quot;,&quot;format&quot;:&quot;rich_text&quot;}}" id="extreme-events" class="paragraph paragraph--type--rich-text paragraph--view-mode--default"><div class="field field--name-field-title field--type-string field--label-hidden field__item"><h2>Extreme events</h2></div><div class="rich-text clearfix text-formatted field field--name-field-text field--type-text-long field--label-hidden field__item"><ul><li>Floods and drought are among the most devastating water-related disasters.</li><li>Over the period 2002–2021, floods caused nearly 100,000 deaths (with an additional 8,000 in 2022), affected another 1.6 billion people (with another 57 million in 2022) and caused US$832 billion in economic losses (US$45 billion in 2022).</li><li>Over the same period, droughts affected over 1.4 billion people, killed over 21,000 more and triggered US$170 billion in economic losses.</li><li>Continued global warming is projected to intensify the global water cycle, and to further increase the frequency and severity of droughts and floods, with more very wet and very dry weather and climate events, and seasons.</li></ul></div></div></div><div class="field__item"><div data-trk="{&quot;block&quot;:{&quot;name&quot;:&quot;Progress towards Sustainable Development Goal (SDG) 6&quot;,&quot;format&quot;:&quot;rich_text&quot;}}" id="progress-towards-sustainable-development-goal-sdg-6" class="paragraph paragraph--type--rich-text paragraph--view-mode--default"><div class="field field--name-field-title field--type-string field--label-hidden field__item"><h2>Progress towards Sustainable Development Goal (SDG) 6</h2></div><div class="rich-text clearfix text-formatted field field--name-field-text field--type-text-long field--label-hidden field__item"><ul><li>SDG 6 seeks to ensure the availability and sustainable management of water and sanitation for all.</li><li>None of the SDG 6 targets appear to be on track.&nbsp;</li><li>As of 2022, 2.2 billion people were without access to safely managed drinking water (SDG Target 6.1).</li><li>Four out of five people lacking at least basic drinking water services in 2022 lived in rural areas.</li><li>The situation with respect to safely managed sanitation (SDG Target 6.2) remains dire, with 3.5 billion people lacking access to such services.</li></ul></div></div></div><div class="field__item"><div data-trk="{&quot;block&quot;:{&quot;name&quot;:&quot;SDG 6 indicators&quot;,&quot;format&quot;:&quot;media&quot;}}" id="sdg-6-indicators" class="paragraph-simple display-big paragraph paragraph--type--media paragraph--view-mode--default"><div class="field field--name-field-title field--type-string field--label-hidden field__item"><h2>SDG 6 indicators</h2></div><div class="wrapper-medias"><div class="field field--name-field-ref-submedia field--type-entity-reference field--label-hidden field__items"><div class="field__item"><div class="submedia"><div class="media media--type-image media--view-mode-media-big"><div class="field field--name-field-media-image field--type-image field--label-hidden field__item"> <picture> <source srcset="/reports/wwdr/sites/default/files/styles/media_image_big_desktop/public/2024-02/FP6_SDG6indicators_horizontal.jpg.webp?itok=x9_JpnBk 1x" media="all and (min-width: 993px)" type="image/webp" width="1038" height="692"/> <source srcset="/reports/wwdr/sites/default/files/styles/medium_fixed_tablet/public/2024-02/FP6_SDG6indicators_horizontal.jpg.webp?itok=icCyYfvx 1x" media="all and (min-width: 576px) and (max-width: 992px)" type="image/webp" width="700" height="466"/> <source paragraph--type--media paragraph--view-mode--default"><div class="field field--name-field-title field--type-string field--label-hidden field__item"><h2>SDG 6 indicators</h2></div><div
